# SegmentedBar

A distribution as one bar: how a dish's ratings split across the taste scale, how a recipe's macros split, how a week's meals split by tier.

`NomNom.SegmentedBar` · Data

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.SegmentedBar segments={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.SegmentedBar" segments="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

A distribution as one bar: reaction tiers, macros, health tiers.

## Props (SegmentedBarProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `segments` * | `{ label: string; value: number; reaction?: Reaction; color?: string }[]` | Widths are each value's share of the sum. `reaction` paints the step's fill and gives the key a reaction Badge; `color` is any other token and gives it a dot. |
| `legend` | `boolean \| 'rows'` | true = Badges and dots wrapped under the bar · 'rows' = a <Card layout="list"> of ListRows, for a full breakdown. |
| `format` | `'count' \| 'percent'` | Legend figures. @default 'count' |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | @default 'md' |
| `label` | `string` | The bar's accessible name. |
| `title` | `string` | Wraps the bar in a <Section> with this SectionHeader; `trailing` is the header's right-hand figure. |
| `trailing` | `unknown` |  |
